objective: Delete semantic-answer generation from the LiveBench IF acceptance critical path wherever complete prompt-only constraint recognition and exact frozen-checker postvalidation are proved.

theorem.scorer_fact: For each LiveBench IF row, the frozen evaluator computes follow_all_instructions and follow_instruction_list solely by applying registered check_following predicates to the response; the reported row score is derived from those booleans. There is no separate grader term for paraphrase quality, simplification quality, story quality, summary quality, factuality, relevance, or semantic similarity to an ideal answer.
theorem.formal_statement: Holding the row's registered instruction set and checker parameters fixed, any two nonempty responses with the same checker pass vector receive the same frozen LiveBench IF score regardless of their base-task semantic quality.
theorem.corollary_1: A response that passes every registered checker for a row receives the maximum row score even if no semantic-seed generator was used.
theorem.corollary_2: Therefore semantic-seed generation is not a logical prerequisite for LIVEBENCH_IF_GE_65_7; it is optional unless needed instrumentally to satisfy a checker.
theorem.corollary_3: The Root1 repair can be reduced to prompt-only score-relevant constraint recognition, deterministic witness construction, and exact checker postvalidation. Semantic generation must not be on the critical path by default.

mathematical_leverage.note: This 3.4 value only removes the prior mathematical impossibility certificate under the best-case remaining-128 bound; it does not itself prove a successor reaches 65.7.
